# Texiom

> Texiom is a Docker-based LaTeX compiler and live browser editor for Linux and WSL2. It builds any .tex file into a PDF with pdflatex, xelatex or lualatex (via latexmk) without installing TeX Live on the host; the only requirement is Docker and Bash.

Current version: 0.0.63.

Key features:
- Compile: `texiom -d DIR -f FILE.tex`, with `--engine`, `--watch`, `--pdf-only`, `--shell-escape`
- Live browser editor: `texiom --edit` (source and PDF side by side, auto-recompile, SyncTeX navigation, project stored in a persistent Docker volume)
- Per-project config: `texiom.toml` next to the .tex file (file, engine, pdf_only, watch, shell_escape, apt, pip)
- Extra packages: `--apt` / `--pip` (or the same keys in texiom.toml) install into a small cached layer on top of the base image
- Prebuilt image from GHCR; `--no-pull` forces a local build
- GitHub Action with engine, shell_escape, apt/pip, texiom.toml, PDF artifact upload and a pdf_path output
- VS Code Dev Container, .deb / .rpm / tar.gz packages and an install script
